title: Storm Clouds Rise Again
next_chapter_hook: The death prophecy of Chapter 700 hangs like a sword over his head. Can Chen Ji seize the initiative in fate's chess game? And how will those mysterious twin fates make their entrance?

text.content:
Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly as he opened the first page of the battered journal. On the yellowed paper, though the ink had faded, it remained clearly legible—'Final Testament of the Fourth Master of the Tianji Record.' And that name... it shared the same name as an ancient elder of the Tianqing Sect who had ascended long ago.

He stared at that name, his heart churning with monstrous waves. Three hundred years ago, Chen Daoxuan, who had ascended, was the most promising genius for immortality in the Tianqing Sect's history—how could he have such a connection to the Tianji Record?

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul sighed faintly within his Mental Sea: 'The inheritance of the Tianji Record has never been severed, and your ancestor... was precisely the Third Master.'

dialogue.content:
'The Third?' Chen Ji suppressed the shock in his heart and asked in a deep voice, 'Then who was the Second? And who was the First?'

Mo Xiansheng's voice drifted uncertainly: 'The name of the Second Master has been erased by Heavenly Dao, and the First... that is an existence I dare not even mention. The journal holds the answer, but what you see now is merely the tip of the iceberg.'

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and continued turning the pages of the journal. With each page, his heart grew heavier. The journal meticulously recorded the fates of each master—

First Master: Missing, suspected to have been taken by Heavenly Dao.
Second Master: Died in madness, sealed the Tianji Record on their deathbed.
Third Master: Chen Daoxuan, successfully ascended, yet left the Tianji Record in the mortal realm.

And the Fourth Master... after the words 'Final Testament,' there were large sections smeared with ink, with only the final line clearly legible: 'Heavenly Dao never lies, but it never tells the whole truth.'

Chen Ji closed the journal and meditated with closed eyes. The gains from the Seven-Day Agreement flashed through his mind— the demonic path alliance was formed, the insider was completely eliminated, the truth of his father's death had begun to surface, and his sister Chen Nian's 'Heavenly Fate Key' ability opened new possibilities.

However, just as he tried to organize this information, a violent tremor suddenly came from within his Mental Sea.

That was the reaction of the Tianji Record Fragment, as if sensing some kind of summons. Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly tensed: 'Not good—the Eye of Heavenly Dao is watching you!'

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji felt his vision go dark, his consciousness forcibly pulled into a chaotic Void. Countless points of light spun around him, like threads of fate intertwining. And in the depths of the Void, a colossal eye slowly opened.

There was no emotion in that eye, only scrutiny— as if examining a meticulously crafted vessel.

'We meet again, Chen Ji.' A voice that couldn't be pinpointed echoed through the Void, 'You are faster than expected, but... still not fast enough.'

text.content:
Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the fear in his heart and asked coldly, 'Who are you?'

'Who I am is not important.' That eye narrowed slightly, 'What matters is, what are you seeking? The complete version of the Tianji Record? Unlocking the shackles of fate? Or... finding your sister who has been missing for years?'

Each word was like a heavy hammer, striking Chen Ji's heart. Only then did he realize that everything about him seemed transparent in the eyes of this being.

choices.description: Maintain the waste persona, preventing the Eye of Heavenly Dao from seeing through his trump cards, retreating to advance.
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may escalate its probing

text.content: Chen Ji gathered his focus, his face taking on his usual timid expression: 'This junior does not understand what the senior means. The Tianji Record... this junior only obtained it by chance and still does not know how to use it.'

choices.description: Directly question the Eye of Heavenly Dao, displaying the protagonist's unyielding will, breaking the opponent's sense of control.
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Eye of Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji straightened his spine, his gaze sharp as a blade: 'You are the Eye of Heavenly Dao? Hmph, I want to ask—what exactly do you want from me?'

That eye fell silent for a moment, then let out an ambiguous laugh.

'Interesting.' Its voice carried a hint of appreciation, 'You are more composed than most seers I've encountered. But you should know—those who peer into Heavenly Secrets will surely be counterattacked by them. The complete version of the Tianji Record... indeed exists.'

Chen Ji's heart lurched, yet he saw a vision suddenly materialize in the Void—a vast秘境, ancient peaks shrouded in clouds, an ancient altar standing quietly atop a mountain. Upon the altar, a fragment faintly emanated a ghostly light.

dialogue.content:
'The first fragment of the complete Tianji Record is hidden in the forbidden realm of the Xuanwu Sect.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice carried a hint of mockery, 'In three months, the three great sects will jointly open the realm for trial. Are you... interested?'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted. A realm jointly opened by three great sects meant Han Lie, Ling Yuan, and others would all participate. And the Eye of Heavenly Dao specifically telling him this news was certainly not out of goodwill.

text.content:
'Why are you telling me this?' Chen Ji asked in a deep voice.

'Because I want to see.' A strange glint flashed in the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil, 'What interesting things will happen when the Twin Fates meet.'

Chen Ji's heart tightened: 'Twin Fates?'

That eye did not answer, merely leaving a chilling phrase as it slowly closed: 'In the realm three months from now, you will see the answer.'

Chen Ji suddenly opened his eyes, finding himself still sitting cross-legged in the meditation chamber. Cold sweat had soaked his back, and the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm was slightly burning.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in his Mental Sea, carrying rare gravity: 'The Eye of Heavenly Dao appearing voluntarily—this is an unprecedented omen. It spoke of Twin Fates... Chen Ji, be careful.'

Chen Ji looked down at the fragment in his hand, his brow furrowed. The complete Tianji Record, the Twin Fates, the three great sects' realm... what connection existed between all these things?

text.content: Chen Ji opened the journal again, this time studying it word by word. In the last few pages of the journal, he discovered a passage deliberately hidden: 'Each master of the Tianji Record leaves behind a remnant consciousness. When two or more remnants meet, the Twin Fates shall awaken—at that time, it is either fusion or destruction.'

Chen Ji set down the journal, lost in thought. The word 'remnant' mentioned in the journal made him recall something.

Did every master of the Tianji Record truly leave behind a remnant consciousness after death? And Mo Xiansheng—who was he the remnant of?

What concerned him even more was—if he was a certain master of the Tianji Record, would the other 'Twin Fate' be another master of the Tianji Record? Two masters meeting—either fusion or destruction... what did this truly mean?

Just as Chen Ji was deep in contemplation, a strange voice suddenly rang out in his Mental Sea.

That voice belonged to neither Mo Xiansheng nor the Eye of Heavenly Dao. It was low and ancient, carrying a sense of vicissitudes spanning endless years—

'Chapter 700, we shall meet eventually.'

Chen Ji shuddered all over, instinctively turned to look. In the depths of his Mental Sea, a blurry figure was slowly emerging. That figure's face was shrouded in mist, impossible to see clearly, but those eyes... those eyes were identical to Chen Ji's own.

dialogue.content:
'Who are you?' Chen Ji demanded sharply, while secretly activating the power of the Tianji Record Fragment.

That figure chuckled lightly, voice carrying a hint of emotion: 'Who am I? I am you, yet not you. I am... the other you.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

'Don't be nervous.' That figure slowly said, 'We won't meet now. But Chapter 700... on that day, you will understand everything. I hope you can make the right choice then.'

Before the words finished, that figure dissipated like a mirage, leaving only echoing syllables in the Mental Sea.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out in the Mental Sea, carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Chen Ji, did you hear that? That is not a remnant, nor a residual soul... that is another consciousness within the Tianji Record's true body!'

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, his gaze profound.

Another self? Twin Fates? The death prophecy of Chapter 700?

All of this seemed to have an invisible hand manipulating everything. And he, Chen Ji, perhaps from the very beginning, had only been a piece on the chessboard.

But—a piece can also devour the chess player, can it not?

A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips, a cold gleam flickering in his eyes: 'Since you want to watch a show, I'll perform for you. But the one who ultimately places the pieces can only be me.'

Outside the window, twilight deepened, and the lights of the Tianqing Sect flickered on one by one.

Chen Ji rose and walked to the window, gazing at the distant horizon. The dust of the Seven-Day Agreement had settled, but new storms were brewing. The realm trial three months away, the appearance of the Twin Fates, and that mysterious 'Chapter 700'...

Every move concerned life and death.

Every step was destiny.

But he, Chen Ji, never believed in so-called fate.

The final sentence from the journal's last page surfaced again in his mind: 'Heavenly Dao never lies, but it never tells the whole truth.'

Since Heavenly Dao doesn't tell the whole truth, then he would speak the whole truth, do everything completely, calculate without omission.

Chapter 700?

Hmph, let that day become the moment when he, Chen Ji, overturns the chessboard!

Storm clouds rise again, the world shall fall into chaos. And in this chaos, he, Chen Ji, shall surely place the pieces and become that variable that stirs the winds of change.
